channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Same Model, Different Harness: CUGA, Hermes, and Deep Agents — When to Pick CUGA?
item.description: Holding the model constant across 90 AppWorld tasks, IBM Research's three-harness comparison of CUGA, Hermes and Deep Agents moved completion from 30% to 81%, with CUGA pitched at enterprises needing enforced rules and in-boundary deployment. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: GitHub Copilot is now available in JetBrains Air
item.description: GitHub Copilot now works in JetBrains Air via the Agent Client Protocol, letting developers delegate coding tasks and review results in the IDE or cloud, where tasks run in Docker containers without retained state. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Heimstaden is changing residential real estate management with AI
item.description: Heimstaden uses OpenAI's ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to overhaul residential property management across Europe, cutting virtual staging costs in the Netherlands from about €50 to under €0.10, a drop of more than 99%. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Look up a resource’s cost center with the GitHub REST API
item.description: GitHub's new REST API endpoint identifies the cost center for a user, organization, repository or enterprise team by resource type and name, returning its ID and name—or empty memberships—without scanning every cost center. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Transformers Model Integration Contracts
item.description: A 66 MB UMT5 fixture lets transformers-mic replay five months of commits on CPU, catching a July 30 to September 28, 2026 regression where enabling PyTorch SDPA let UMT5's decoder attend to future tokens. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: The latest AI news we announced in October 2026
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon launched globally for developers and enterprises in October 2026, followed two weeks later by Gemini 4 Carbon for long-term engineering and cybersecurity defense, with Google also introducing Genie 4 for real-time interactive simulations. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: CodeQL 2.27.3 adds Python 3.15 features and JSON data extensions
item.description: CodeQL 2.27.3, the static analysis engine behind GitHub code scanning, adds Python 3.15 language features, JSON syntax for data extensions and C23 bit-precise integers, while improving multi-language analysis accuracy. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties
item.description: OpenAI has raised median Security Bug Bounty payouts for medium, high and critical vulnerabilities more than fourfold, with critical flaws in core products like ChatGPT now topping $30,000 and quality, loyalty and priority campaign bonuses pushing exceptional finds to $172,000. (OpenAI News)

item.title: AI benchmarks shift toward real-world task execution as OpenAI launches LifeVal to measure personal assistant capabilities
item.description: OpenAI's LifeVal benchmark, built from a survey of 3,995 respondents, tests whether AI assistants can carry everyday caregiving, health, education and household tasks through to executable deliverables, with a public-test choosing-a-kindergarten task scoring 93.1%. (AIbase)

item.title: Dependabot now supports Python 3.15
item.description: Dependabot now supports Python 3.15, letting all github.com users upgrade projects while still receiving dependency updates, with the capability also slated for GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Preparing our next security sprint to harden OpenAI
item.description: OpenAI is planning its next internal security sprint with Cathedral Systems to stress-test defenses using its own models, with rewards for key findings raised more than fourfold after 25% of product engineers used Codex to reproduce vulnerabilities and prepare patches. (OpenAI News)

item.title: EV demand cools, AI storage heats up: LG Energy Solution shifts capacity to data centers
item.description: LG Energy Solution plans to lift pouch-type ESS capacity above 50 GWh by year-end and 70 GWh next year, with a 160 GWh Q3 backlog, as CFO Lee Chang-sil pivots toward AI data centers and joins Nvidia’s DSX Ready program. (AIbase)

item.title: GitHub Desktop adds short-lived authentication tokens
item.description: GitHub Desktop 3.6.10 and later now gives eligible accounts short-lived, automatically refreshing authentication tokens, reducing a leaked token's usable window and auto-renewing them for GitHub API requests and Git operations, though the rollout excludes GitHub Enterprise Server. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: UN Under-Secretary-General Applauds Qwen AI Clip-On Earbuds at Wuzhen Internet Conference Debut
item.description: At the Wuzhen Internet Conference on November 3, UN Under-Secretary-General Li Junhua tried on Qwen AI clip-on earbuds and praised their translation, meeting-minutes and sound quality, with the Bose-tuned product having gone on sale October 13. (AIbase)

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan unveils Hyra 2.0, letting AI Agents take full part in scientific foundation models and hardcore R&D
item.description: Tencent Hunyuan's Hyra 2.0 puts general AI agents into scientific tool and model R&D, after Hyra 1.0, built on Hy3, autonomously solved the 50-year-old optimal exponent problem for sum sets and difference sets. (AIbase)

item.title: Apple Watch gains Audio Intelligence, with conversation summaries and live rewind now in Beta testing
item.description: Apple Watch's Audio Intelligence, first previewed at Apple's September hardware event, has entered beta testing, with Live Rewind letting users double-click the Digital Crown to view the previous 15 seconds of conversation text. (AIbase)

item.title: Apple is all in on AI — its own and everyone else’s
item.description: AI came up 45 times on Apple's earnings call, where the company pitched its 2.5 billion active devices as an AI entry point while spending just $2.2 billion on capex, far below Amazon's $77.3 billion and Alphabet's $51.4 billion. (The Verge)

item.title: Run 128K ultra-long context on just 8GB of VRAM! Open-source local LLM tool Strata 0.2.10 released
item.description: Strata 0.2.10 dynamically adjusts VRAM and RAM allocation so 8GB-VRAM devices can run Qwen3.8IQ3_S at a 128K (131,072-token) context, with official DFlash2-mode tests generating 63–73 tokens/s. (AIbase)

item.title: Teamily AI — Your personal agent, agent teams & people in one messenger
item.description: Teamily AI pitches a single messenger that combines a personal agent, agent teams and real people, though the page currently serves only a CAPTCHA check with no further product details available. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Here’s Why You Shouldn’t Use AI to Vote
item.description: Pew found about 50% of U.S. adults used AI chatbots and 8% checked candidates or policies, while Forum AI found nearly 40% of answers had factual errors, including Gemini listing Pennsylvania’s mail-ballot deadline as Nov. 3 instead of Oct. 27. (Wired AI)
